note: These records are canonical Intuition ID plans, not claims already written onchain. A connected wallet must create the missing atoms and triples before the registry can display them as live evidence.

relationships.context: A FunctionCall scope where the call sends native value
relationships.evidenceNote: FunctionCall pins ValueLteEnforcer to 0 and silently ignores maxValue, so a payable call is not compatible with that scope.

relationships.context: A native-token transfer scope that needs calldata
relationships.evidenceNote: NativeTokenTransferAmount defaults ExactCalldataEnforcer to 0x and blocks all calldata; AllowedCalldataEnforcer replaces that default.

relationships.context: A scoped agent action set with the same delegation target and method set
relationships.ordering: Resolve the allowed target set before evaluating the allowed method set.
relationships.evidenceNote: AllowedTargets, AllowedMethods, LimitedCalls, and Timestamp compose cleanly as a scoped-agent-action set.

relationships.context: A scoped agent action set with the same delegation target and call counter
relationships.ordering: Resolve the allowed target set before consuming the call counter.
relationships.evidenceNote: AllowedTargets, AllowedMethods, LimitedCalls, and Timestamp compose cleanly as a scoped-agent-action set.

relationships.context: A scoped agent action set with the same delegation target and time window
relationships.ordering: Resolve the time window before executing the target-bound call.
relationships.evidenceNote: AllowedTargets, AllowedMethods, LimitedCalls, and Timestamp compose cleanly as a scoped-agent-action set.
